# Scaltiva

> Scaltiva is a digital agency offering web development, business automation, SEO and digital marketing from one team.

## Services

- [Web development](https://scaltiva.com/services/development): custom websites, web apps and online stores built with React, Node.js and MongoDB.
- [Business automation](https://scaltiva.com/services/automation): workflow automation, CRM and API integrations, and AI assistants.
- [SEO](https://scaltiva.com/services/seo): technical SEO, content, local SEO and AI search optimization.
- [Digital marketing](https://scaltiva.com/services/marketing): strategy, paid ads, social media, email and content marketing.

- [How it works](https://scaltiva.com/how-it-works): our process from first call to launch and support.
